lines.x: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed lower as Nvidia and technology shares surrendered recent gains.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped over 1,100 points while the S&P 500 extended losses into a sixth straight session.
Spot gold fell over 1% to its lowest level in more than a year, pressured by a firmer dollar and expectations of higher US interest rates ahead of Federal Reserve minutes.
Major U.S. stock benchmarks are on pace for their steepest weekly decline since April 2025 tariffs, falling broadly even as Anthropic's stock surged in its debut.
